bank_fees.description: Bank charges or fees deducted from the payment, each with its amount and the currency code. Empty when none are stated.
bank_fees.title: Bank Fees

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code (three capital letters) only when the remittance makes it certain. A bare '$' is not certain: leave the value null for it.

currency_ambiguous.description: true when the currency is written with a bare '$' or any other symbol that fits more than one currency and nothing else on the document settles it.
currency_ambiguous.title: Currency Ambiguous

currency_raw.description: The currency exactly as written (for example 'USD', 'US$', '$', 'EUR', 'Rs.'). Do not convert it.

dates.description: Every date on the remittance that could matter, each with its kind: payment (the date the money was or will be paid), issue (the remittance or document date), order, deposit, or other. Keep all of them, even when they differ.
dates.title: Dates

ers_refs.description: Every evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) reference on the remittance.
ers_refs.title: Ers Refs

lines.description: One entry per line of the remittance, in the order printed: invoices, credit memos, bank fees, tariffs and discount lines. Include a line even when it states no amount.
lines.title: Lines

notes.description: Anything else useful for matching that does not fit a field above (for example 'prepayment', 'partial payment', 'two currencies'). Never put personal data here. null if nothing.
notes.title: Notes

payer_bank_account.description: The payer's bank account or IBAN as printed, if any. Keep it exactly as shown, as a string.

payer_name.description: The name of the party that made the payment, as written on the remittance (the remitter, not the payee that receives the money).

payment_amount.description: The total amount of the payment as a decimal string with two decimals, for example '12480.00'. Never a number type, never with a currency symbol or thousands separator.

payment_date.description: The one date you judge to be the payment date, chosen from the dates you listed. null when no date can be justified as the payment date.

po_refs.description: Every purchase order number on the remittance, as strings.
po_refs.title: Po Refs

remittance_reference.description: The payer's own reference for this payment: remittance advice number, payment number, check or EFT number, or the document title reference. A string.

sales_order_refs.description: Every sales order number on the remittance, as strings.
sales_order_refs.title: Sales Order Refs

bbox.description: The region of the page holding the value, as fractions of the page width and height (x, y of the top-left corner, w, h of the box), each from 0 to 1. null when unknown.

page.description: The 1-based page within the part, or null for parts that have no pages.
page.title: Page

part_no.description: The number of the artifact part, counting from 1 in the order the parts were supplied.
part_no.title: Part No

quote.description: The short text read at that location, at most 300 characters. null if none.
quote.title: Quote
